description: Connect booking approval to student notifications with socket events
steps: Modify backend/src/controllers/counselor/appointmentController.js updateAppointmentStatus function to emit socket event 'appointment-approved' to student when status changes to 'Confirmed'
Add sendStudentNotification call in updateAppointmentStatus when status becomes 'Confirmed'
Add socket event handler in frontend/src/screens/student/home.tsx for 'appointment-approved' event to show toast/alert
Add socket event handler in frontend/src/screens/student/my-appointments.tsx to refresh appointment list when 'appointment-approved' is received
acceptance_criteria: When counselor approves a pending appointment, student receives real-time notification
Student's My Appointments screen updates to show 'Confirmed' status
Student sees visual indicator (toast or modal) for the new appointment status
verification: Start backend and frontend, login as counselor and approve a pending appointment
Switch to student account and verify notification appears in Home screen
Verify My Appointments screen shows 'Confirmed' status for the approved appointment
